plan.title: Recreate Closed RFQ with 24-Hour End Duration

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's project summary page.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the stage settings menu.
Assert the recreation dialog contains the Product Sheet section.
Assert the recreation dialog contains auction configuration settings.
Assert the recreation dialog contains the delivery date setting.
Assert the recreation dialog exposes the scheduling choice.
Assert the event end-time duration options include the required 24 Hrs choice.
Select the required 24-hour event end-time duration.
Assert the evaluation duration remains 30 Mins.
Create the recreated event with the selected duration and no schedule.
Assert the newly recreated event is live immediately.
Verify the recreated event shows the API-backed line-item quantity.
Verify the recreated event shows the API-backed line-item unit.
